sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def sq(f):
    o={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbN' and n['pixels']>=10 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<50:
            bb=n['boundary']; o.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(p[0] for p in bb),max(p[0] for p in bb),min(p[1] for p in bb),max(p[1] for p in bb)))
    return o
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def beamrows():
    rows=[r for r in range(10,45) if a[r][16] in 'wg' or a[r][17] in 'wg']
    return (min(rows),max(rows)) if rows else None
print('start:', sq(current_frame), 'beam=',beamrows())
r=action(['DOWN'], intent='explore')
print('after DOWN:', sq(current_frame), 'beam=',beamrows(), 'res=',{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('no_impact','board_changed','level_completed')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def sq(f):
    o={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbN' and n['pixels']>=10 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<50:
            bb=n['boundary']; o.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(p[0] for p in bb),max(p[0] for p in bb),min(p[1] for p in bb),max(p[1] for p in bb)))
    return o
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def beamrows():
    rows=[r for r in range(10,45) if a[r][16] in 'wg' or a[r][17] in 'wg']
    return (min(rows),max(rows)) if rows else None
print('start:', sq(current_frame), 'beam=',beamrows())
r=action(['DOWN'], intent='explore')
print('after DOWN:', sq(current_frame), 'beam=',beamrows(), 'res=',{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('no_impact','board_changed','level_completed')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
